symptom: `alter enumeration M.E set comment 'text';` parsed, `exec` reported success, and the enumeration's documentation was never written: the statement built nothing.
cause: The grammar had `SET COMMENT STRING_LITERAL` in alterEnumerationAction, but ExitAlterEnumerationAction's if/else chain handled only add/drop/rename/modify value, so the alternative fell off the end and appended no statement; there was no AST operation for it either.
insight: New AlterEnumSetDocumentation op built for `set documentation` and its alias `set comment` (MDL-DEPR135), executed as a read-modify-write of Enumeration.Documentation. Shape to look for: a grammar alternative in an action rule whose visitor is an if/else chain with no final else — grep each action rule's alternatives against the chain; a parse that yields zero statements is silent. Test TestAlterEnumerationSetDocumentationBuildsAStatement (fails with the branch disabled) and TestAlterEnumeration_SetDocumentation_Mock. ako/mxcli#755.
